body: The Boeing 777X is not only Boeing's latest aircraft project, but in some metrics it is also the largest design ever to come out of Washington. The Boeing 777-9 is 251 ft 9 in (76.73 m) long, making it the longest airliner ever put into production, ahead of the previous titleholder, the Boeing 747-8 at 250 ft 2 in (76.25 m). The Airbus A380, meanwhile, is 238 ft 8 in (72.73 m), a full 13 ft 1 in (4 m) shorter. The 777-9 is not the only aircraft longer than the A380: the Boeing 777-300ER measures 242 ft 4 in (73.9 m), and in Airbus's own lineup the A350-1000 and the out-of-production A340-600, at 247 ft 5 in (75.4 m), also beat the A380 on length. The source notes that the A380 is relatively short because its design was optimised for a larger A380-900, giving the aircraft as built the economics of a shrink, which contributed to the failure of the A380 program.

On every other metric, the A380 still reigns supreme. The 777-9's wingspan is 235 ft 5 in (71.75 m) unfolded and 212 ft 9 in (64.84 m) folded, wider than any Boeing 747 variant: the 747-8 spans 224 ft 5 in (68.4 m). The A380, however, spans 261 ft 8 in (79.75 m), more than any other passenger plane ever made, behind only the Antonov An-225, the Hughes H-4 Hercules and the Stratolaunch. On weight, the 777-9 has a maximum takeoff weight of 351T and the 777-8F is projected to lift up to 365T, while the A380 is rated for up to 575T and the 747-8 for 447T. The 777-9 is 64 ft 1 in (19.53 m) tall, against 60 ft 8 in (18.5 m) for the older 777, but the A380 stands 79 ft (24.09 m) tall. Exit limits tell the same story: 475 for the 777-9 against 853 for the A380. The A380 remains the largest airliner ever made and the largest conventional plane currently flying, second only to the destroyed Antonov An-225 Mriya among conventional aircraft ever manufactured.

The 777X's size comes from Boeing's response to a competitive threat. The Boeing 777-300ER is by far the most successful variant of the 777 family, selling over 800 copies and essentially rendering quadjets obsolete, but when Airbus redesigned the A350 into a 777-sized airliner, Boeing's star widebody was in serious trouble. The response was to fix the 777's undersized wing and stretch the fuselage to cut per-seat costs, while adding the General Electric GE9X engine, a reworked cabin with larger dimming windows and a lower cabin altitude matching the 787, and a cockpit redesigned to resemble the 787, with a common-type rating with the 787 in some jurisdictions. The 777X has more than 500 passenger orders, 270 of them from Emirates, more than double the orders of the A380, and many of its customers also operate the A350 and plan to offer first class on the 777X. But the source also notes the 777X is set to enter service seven years past its original target, and that when two airliners have equal per-seat costs, airlines will always choose the smaller plane because it is less risky, so the 777X will ultimately be judged on whether its operating economics justify its size against the A350.
en.summary: The 777-9 is the longest airliner ever built at 251 ft 9 in, but the A380 still wins on wingspan (261 ft 8 in), height (79 ft) and maximum takeoff weight (575T). The 777X's size gives it a market niche and more than 500 orders, but it must prove its economics against the A350.
en.title: Is a Boeing 777X bigger than an Airbus A380?

body: 波音777X不只是波音最新的飛機計畫，在部分指標上也是華盛頓州有史以來最大的飛機設計。777-9機身長251英尺9英寸（76.73公尺），是有史以來投入生產的最長客機，超過前任紀錄保持者波音747-8的250英尺2英寸（76.25公尺）；空中巴士A380長238英尺8英寸（72.73公尺），比777-9短13英尺1英寸（4公尺）。比A380長的飛機不只777-9：波音777-300ER長242英尺4英寸（73.9公尺），空中巴士自家陣容中的A350-1000與已停產的A340-600（247英尺5英寸，75.4公尺）也都比A380長。來源指出，A380相對較短是因為設計原本為更大的A380-900最佳化，實際推出的機型形同縮小版，影響了單位座位成本，也成為A380計畫失敗的因素之一。

長度之外，A380在其餘指標上仍居首位。777-9翼展235英尺5英寸（71.75公尺），展開時比任何波音747都寬，747-8翼展為224英尺5英寸（68.4公尺）；但A380翼展達261英尺8英寸（79.75公尺），是史上所有客機之冠，僅次於安托諾夫An-225、休斯H-4大力神與Stratolaunch。最大起飛重量方面，777-9為351噸，777-8F預計可達365噸，A380則為575噸，747-8為447噸。高度方面，777-9高64英尺1英寸（19.53公尺），高於舊款777的60英尺8英寸（18.5公尺），但A380高79英尺（24.09公尺），仍明顯更高。緊急出口人數上限方面，777-9為475人，A380為853人。整體而言，A380仍是史上最大的客機，也是目前現役最大的傳統構型飛機，僅次於已遭摧毀的安托諾夫An-225。

777X的龐大身形來自波音的應對策略。777-300ER是有史以來最成功的777衍生型，售出逾800架，基本淘汰了四發動機客機；但空中巴士將A350重新設計為777等級的飛機後，波音的主力廣體客機面臨壓力，777X因此加大機翼、拉長機身，以提升燃油效率並降低單位座位成本。777X也帶來通用電氣GE9X發動機、全新客艙（更大的可調光窗戶、與787相同的較低客艙高度）與類似787的駕駛艙設計，部分司法管轄區內777與787享有共同型別檢定。訂單方面，777X客機訂單逾500架，其中270架來自阿聯酋航空，總數已超過A380訂單的兩倍；多數客戶同時營運A350，並計畫在777X上提供頭等艙。不過來源也指出，777X預計較原定目標晚七年投入服務，面對全新且高效的A350競爭，機身越大、需要售出的機票越多，航空公司在單位座位成本相同時總會選擇較小的飛機，因此777X最終仍須以營運經濟性證明其龐大身形的價值。
zh.summary: 777-9機身長251英尺9英寸，是有史以來投入生產的最長客機，但A380在翼展（261英尺8英寸）、高度（79英尺）與最大起飛重量（575噸）上仍居首位。777X的龐大身形為其爭取到逾500架訂單的市場定位，但面對A350的競爭，仍須以營運經濟性證明自身價值。
zh.title: 波音777X比空中巴士A380大嗎？長度、翼展與起飛重量的全面比較
